entities.name: Cosmium
entities.description: A pinkish-purple mineral of immense power found in the Core of Ixalan.

entities.name: The Core
entities.description: Core of Ixalan where cosmium is densest.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: Star caged by the Coin Empire who freed herself and introduced cosmium.

entities.name: Night War
entities.description: War during which Chimil released cosmium.

entities.name: Oltec
entities.description: Ancient civilization of the Core that mastered cosmium.

entities.name: Komon
entities.description: People innervated by cosmium who became the first angels of Ixalan.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: Land whose wealthy prize cosmium and whose vampires ingest it.

entities.name: Gnomes
entities.description: Cosmium-powered artifact servants of the Oltec.

events.summary: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec attack the colonizers and Chimil destroys her prison.
events.quote: After 320 years of darkness, the Oltec launched a final attack against the colonizers

events.summary: Cosmium lashes out from Chimil, blasting the colonizers and creating the first angels from the Komon.
events.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers
